overview: Bern telegram relays a German paper's account of Japan's wartime textile-mill conversion, with a percentage breakdown as of May 1943.

people.name: Leland Harrison
people.role: U.S. Minister to Switzerland; sender of the telegram from Bern

subfiles.title: Telegram from Bern on wartime changes in the Japanese textile industry
subfiles.about: Reports a German newspaper’s summary of Japanese press information concerning the wartime disposition and conversion of Japan’s textile mills.
subfiles.summary: Harrison relays a German paper's account of Japan's textile mills being sold, converted, or idled since 1937, intensified by 1941 embargoes, with a percentage breakdown as of May 1943.

interest: Relays a 1943 German press account of Japan's textile conversion.
